keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["keepInlineImagesIn" => ["a"]]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/file.pdf\"><img src=\"pdf.png\"><p>Download PDF</p></a>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
